title: Observability: write() silent failures on protocol errors
description: write() returns -EINVAL (lines 408, 419) or -EIO (line 413) with no log for three distinct conditions: (a) fd already finalized, (b) IV required but not yet set, (c) fd in error state. A support engineer cannot distinguish these from the ring buffer. The state->error = true path (line 445) does log the underlying wolfCrypt error, but the subsequent write() calls that then hit -EIO (line 413) are silent. 'Why is write() returning -EIO on an OPERATION fd?' has no answer from the ring buffer unless you happened to catch the original finalize/update failure.
